scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/core && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/database && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/integrations && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/runtime && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/cli && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/api && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-miniprogram-questionnaire.mjs && npm run build --workspace @kangmin/admin
